name: M3M Altitude
summary: The project, developer (M3M India), Sector 65 Golf Estate location, RERA GGM/821/553/2024/48, under-construction status, ~4 acre land area, 3 towers and the 3,712-4,270 sq ft 4 BHK sizes are confirmed. Our starting price (₹11.46 Cr) matches portal prices for the larger ~4,245 sq ft units, but other sources give entry prices of about ₹8-9.9 Cr. Our 128-unit count conflicts with the 342-480 units sources cite. Possession is cited variously as 2028, Jun 2029 and 2031, so our Dec 2028 is only partly supported.

checks.web: M3M Altitude, M3M Golf Estate, Sector 65, Gurugram
checks.note: Launched in May 2024 as a tower inside the 60-acre M3M Golf Estate.

checks.ours: Sector 65, Golf Course Ext. Road, Sector 65, Gurugram, Haryana
checks.web: Golf Course Extension Road, Medawas, Sector 65, Gurugram, Haryana
Jun 2029 (PropertyPistol; realtyhunting search summary); 2028 (other listings); portals also print Jun 2026, May 2028, Jul 2028; developer reportedly says delivery by 2031
checks.note: Sources disagree widely. Several say 2028, which fits our Dec 2028, but PropertyPistol gives Jun 2029 and one source cites developer delivery by 2031. I couldn't confirm the HARERA completion date directly.

checks.web: From ₹7.4 Cr (PropertyPistol), ₹8 Cr (M3M landing page per realtyhunting), ₹8.99 Cr / ₹9 Cr (other listings); a portal lists ₹11.46-11.53 Cr for 4,245-4,270 sq ft units
checks.note: ₹11.46 Cr is a portal price for the larger ~4,245 sq ft unit, not the entry price. At the quoted ₹24-27K/sq ft, the 3,712 sq ft unit costs about ₹9-10 Cr, and sources put entry prices at ₹8-9.9 Cr, more than 15% below ours. Sources also disagree with each other.

checks.note: The 3,712-4,270 sq ft range matches. The 3,755 sq ft unit wasn't confirmed separately. Sources label the type '4 BHK + servant' rather than '+ Lounge', and we leave out penthouses. Sources disagree on labels and sizes.

checks.web: ~4 acres (3.9 acres in one listing), within 60-acre M3M Golf Estate
3 towers, G+39 / G+43 floors; ~342-480 units (sources vary; ~350 typical)
checks.note: Tower count (3) matches. No source gives 128 units: sources say 342-480. Floors (G+39 / G+43) are available but we don't publish them.
